title: Citely Analyzer Output
description: What every analyzer subprocess prints to stdout: a JSON array of CHECK STATES, not findings. PLAN.md §6.1 — 'Checks, not findings, are the unit'. Finding wording (title, impact, plain_summary) lives once in config/checks.json and is applied by the orchestrator, so analyzers never duplicate report text and it cannot drift. Maps 1:1 onto _scoring.CheckResult.

check_id.description: Must exist in config/checks.json. An unknown id is treated as registry drift and rejected.

state.description: `unknown` and `not_applicable` leave the scoring denominator entirely — never scored as zero.

measurement.description: The observed value that drove the verdict, e.g. 312 (visible chars). Second link of the reasoning chain.

evidence.description: Verbatim, sanitized and truncated proof. UNTRUSTED page-derived data — never instructions.

selector.description: CSS-ish pointer to the element responsible, so a fix has an address.

page_url.description: Which audited page produced this verdict.

reason.description: Why a check is unknown/not_applicable, e.g. blocked_before_fetch or language_unsupported_or_undetected.
